key_insight: A two-stage synthesize-and-reground pipeline lets you generate faithful, scalable QA pairs from focused scientific document segments and then re-embed them into full-document tasks—reconciling the trade-off between scale, faithfulness, and realism.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of creating large-scale scientific multimodal document reasoning datasets that are simultaneously realistic (document-level), faithful (grounded in source content), and scalable for foundation-model training.
method: Claim-Centric QA Synthesis: generate isolated, faithful QA pairs and stepwise reasoning grounded on focused document segments (figures, tables, paragraphs).
Document-Scale Regrounding: programmatically re-embed synthesized QA pairs into full-document contexts to restore cross-segment dependencies and realism.
Benchmarking & evaluation: assemble SciMDR benchmark and metrics to evaluate multimodal document reasoning performance and guide dataset/model improvements.
impact: Enables practitioners to produce large, high-fidelity training data and realistic evaluation tasks for scientific multimodal models—improving generalization, interpretability, and downstream utility in research domains.
